My dear Miss Yonge,                                                                       

I omitted yesterday to say that I had sent to [your bankers](/organisation/169) the amount of £275 – due at midsummer.

Also that I am reading [Miss Peard](/person/1160)’s “story of Prayer Book” , and I hope with perhaps a little modification, it may come well into [our Series](/topic/145), but not early.

With all kind New Year wishes

Yours very faithfully

[A.

Macmillan](/person/939)

&nbsp;
